description: This file implements the internal server-side logic for managing media key sessions, including creation, deletion, encryption/decryption, and session state management within the Rialto media framework. It defines classes and functions for handling media key sessions, interacting with the main thread, and managing DRM stores.

classes.name: MediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Implements internal server-side management of media key sessions, including creation, deletion, encryption, decryption, and session state handling within the Rialto DRM framework.
